tagline.en: AI avatar and talking head videos from a portrait
tagline.zh: 由肖像图生成 AI 数字人与口播视频

summary.en: This skill creates talking head and avatar videos from a portrait image. It runs apps through the inference.sh belt CLI. The recommended app, P-Video-Avatar, creates speech from a text script with built-in TTS, so you do not need a separate audio step.
summary.zh: 这个技能用一张肖像图生成口播视频和数字人视频，通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行应用。推荐使用的 P-Video-Avatar 内置语音合成，可以直接根据文字脚本生成语音，不需要单独的音频步骤。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 调用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image models from the command line through the belt CLI and inference.sh. It covers text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, LoRA styles, upscaling and text rendering. It gives you one way to call many image models, such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 belt CLI 和 inference.sh 在命令行中调用 AI 图片模型。它支持文生图、图片编辑、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、放大和文字渲染。你可以用同一种方式调用 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等多个模型。

tagline.en: Generate AI videos from text, images, and references
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 生成 AI 视频

summary.en: This skill runs AI video models through the belt CLI from inference.sh. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, avatars and lipsync, video editing, upscaling, and sound effects. You pick a model by its app ID and pass a JSON input.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 AI 视频模型。支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、数字人与口型同步、视频编辑、超分和音效生成。你用应用 ID 选择模型，再传入 JSON 输入。

tagline.en: Distinct visual design for new or existing UI
tagline.zh: 为新建或现有界面做有辨识度的视觉设计

summary.en: Guidance for designing UI with a distinct visual identity instead of template defaults. It covers aesthetic direction, typography, layout, and copy, and asks the agent to plan and review before writing code. The aim is a design that fits the brief's subject and does not look like a generated page.
summary.zh: 这是一套界面视觉设计指南，目标是让界面有自己的风格，而不是套用模板。内容包括审美方向、字体、版面和文案。代理在写代码前会先做方案并自我审查。结果应贴合需求的主题，而不像生成的通用页面。

tagline.en: Create, test and improve agent skills
tagline.zh: 创建、测试并改进智能体技能

summary.en: Skill Creator helps you build a new agent skill or improve an existing one. It covers the whole cycle: defining the skill, writing a draft SKILL.md, running test prompts, reviewing results, and revising. It also includes a method for tuning the skill description so the skill triggers for the right requests.
summary.zh: Skill Creator 帮你新建一个智能体技能，或改进已有的技能。它覆盖完整流程：明确技能要做什么，写出 SKILL.md 草稿，运行测试提示词，查看结果，再进行修改。它还提供调整技能描述的方法，让技能在正确的请求下被触发。

tagline.en: Persistent Chromium profiles with fixed device fingerprints
tagline.zh: 每个配置文件固定一套真实设备指纹的 Chromium

summary.en: anti-detect-browser lets you drive Chromium through standard Playwright APIs in JavaScript or Python. Each profile keeps one device fingerprint, cookies and storage across runs, and can use its own proxy. It is for keeping separate accounts apart and for testing sites under controlled device and region settings.
summary.zh: anti-detect-browser 让你用标准 Playwright 接口驱动 Chromium，支持 JavaScript 和 Python。每个配置文件在多次运行之间保留同一套设备指纹、Cookie 和存储，并可绑定自己的代理。适合管理彼此隔离的账号，以及在可控的设备和地区条件下测试网站。

tagline.en: Ranked conversion fix list for landing and checkout pages
tagline.zh: 落地页转化审计，输出按收益排序的修复清单

summary.en: This skill audits a landing page, sales page, opt-in page, product page or checkout flow for conversion leaks. It returns a fix list ordered by expected revenue impact, where each finding names the element, the failure mode and the change to make. It is meant for pages that get paid traffic but do not convert well.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于审计落地页、销售页、留资页、产品页和结账流程中的转化漏点。它会输出一份按预期收益影响排序的修复清单，每条发现都写明具体元素、问题类型和应做的修改。它适用于已经有付费流量、但转化效果不好的页面。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via one CLI
tagline.zh: 通过一个 CLI 调用 50 多个 AI 模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image generation, editing, inpainting, and upscaling through the inference.sh `belt` CLI. It covers models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve from one command interface. It is meant for art, mockups, social graphics, and marketing visuals.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 `belt` CLI 完成 AI 图片生成、编辑、局部重绘和放大。它在同一套命令下支持 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等模型。适用于艺术创作、产品效果图、社交媒体图和营销视觉。

tagline.en: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 代理的浏览器自动化工具

summary.en: Browser automation for AI agents, run through the inference.sh belt CLI. It opens pages, lists interactive elements as @e refs, and lets an agent click, fill, drag, upload, and run JavaScript. It can also take screenshots and record video of a session.
summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 代理的浏览器自动化技能，通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行。它可以打开页面，把可交互元素列为 @e 引用，并让代理执行点击、填写、拖放、上传文件和运行 JavaScript 等操作。它还能截图，并录制会话视频。

tagline.en: Run hosted AI apps from a CLI, no GPU needed
tagline.zh: 在命令行运行云端AI应用，无需GPU

summary.en: agent-tools is a skill that gives an agent access to inference.sh through the belt CLI. It can run hosted AI apps for images, video, LLMs, web search, 3D generation, and Twitter/X actions. You pass each app a JSON input and get the result back, without setting up your own models or GPUs.
summary.zh: agent-tools 是一个技能，让智能体通过 belt CLI 使用 inference.sh。它可以运行云端托管的 AI 应用，用于生成图片和视频、调用大语言模型、网页搜索、生成 3D 模型，以及执行 Twitter/X 操作。每个应用接收一段 JSON 输入并返回结果，无需自己部署模型或配置 GPU。

tagline.en: Generate AI videos from text, images and references
tagline.zh: 用文字、图片和参考图生成 AI 视频

summary.en: This skill runs AI video models from the command line through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, lipsync, avatars, video editing, upscaling and sound effects, with 40+ models such as Veo, Seedance, Kling, Wan and HappyHorse.
summary.zh: 这个 skill 通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具调用 AI 视频模型。它支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、口型同步、数字人、视频编辑、超分和音效，覆盖 Veo、Seedance、Kling、Wan、HappyHorse 等 40 多个模型。

tagline.en: Store screenshot specs, gallery order and preview videos
tagline.zh: 商店截图规范、图库顺序与预览视频

summary.en: This skill helps you make App Store and Google Play screenshots and preview videos. It lists the exact iOS and Android sizes, the order of the gallery, caption rules, and how to generate images and video with the belt CLI from inference.sh. It is for developers who want listing images that meet store specs and show the app's value in the first three screenshots.
summary.zh: 这个技能帮你制作 App Store 和 Google Play 的截图与预览视频。它列出 iOS 和 Android 的准确尺寸、图库排列顺序、文案规则，并说明如何通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具生成图片和视频。适合希望商店素材符合规范，并在前三张截图中展示应用价值的开发者。

tagline.en: Consistent AI-generated characters with reference sheets
tagline.zh: 用参考设定表保持AI角色形象一致

summary.en: A skill for keeping one character looking the same across many AI-generated images. It covers turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, a reusable description anchor, and LoRA training. It runs through the inference.sh CLI (belt).
summary.zh: 这个技能用于让同一角色在多张AI生成图片中保持一致。内容包括多角度设定图、表情表、配色表、可复用的外貌描述，以及LoRA训练方法。它通过inference.sh的命令行工具belt运行。

tagline.en: Structured competitor analysis: research, matrices, SWOT, UX
tagline.zh: 结构化竞品分析：调研、对比矩阵与SWOT

summary.en: Competitor Teardown gives a structure for analyzing competitors across product, pricing, positioning, traction, reviews, content, and team. It runs research queries and page screenshots through the inference.sh belt CLI. It also provides templates for feature matrices, pricing tables, SWOT, positioning maps, and summary reports.
summary.zh: Competitor Teardown 提供一套竞品分析结构，覆盖产品、定价、定位、增长、用户评价、内容和团队七个层面。它通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 执行调研查询和页面截图。同时提供功能矩阵、价格对比、SWOT、定位图和汇总报告的模板。

tagline.en: Turn still images into short animated video clips
tagline.zh: 把静态图片变成带动态的短视频

summary.en: A guide for turning still images into short videos with the belt CLI. It covers which image-to-video model to use, how to write motion prompts, and how to specify camera movement. It includes models such as Wan 2.7 i2v, Seedance 2.5, and Kling v4.
summary.zh: 这是一份使用 belt CLI 把静态图片转为短视频的指南。内容包括如何选择图生视频模型、如何写运动提示词，以及如何设置镜头运动。涵盖 Wan 2.7 i2v、Seedance 2.5、Kling v4 等模型。

tagline.en: Run cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs and search
tagline.zh: 命令行运行云端AI应用，覆盖图像、视频、大模型与搜索

summary.en: infsh-cli is a command-line tool for running hosted AI apps on inference.sh. It covers image and video generation, LLM calls, web search, 3D generation and Twitter/X actions, all through the `belt` command. The apps run in the cloud, so no local GPU is needed.
summary.zh: infsh-cli 是一个命令行工具，用于运行 inference.sh 上托管的 AI 应用。它通过 `belt` 命令提供图像和视频生成、大模型调用、网页搜索、3D 生成以及 Twitter/X 操作。应用在云端运行，不需要本地 GPU。

tagline.en: Layout and copy rules for landing pages that convert
tagline.zh: 落地页转化设计的布局与文案规则

summary.en: This skill gives rules for designing landing pages that convert. It covers the above-the-fold layout, headlines, hero images, CTA buttons, section order, forms, and mobile design. It also includes belt CLI commands to generate hero and OG images and to run web research.
summary.zh: 这个技能提供落地页转化设计的规则，涵盖首屏布局、标题、主图、CTA 按钮、板块顺序、表单和移动端设计。它还提供 belt CLI 命令，用于生成首图和分享图，以及进行网页调研。

tagline.en: Plan and prepare a Product Hunt launch
tagline.zh: 规划并准备 Product Hunt 产品发布

summary.en: This skill helps you plan a Product Hunt launch. It covers listing specs, gallery images, taglines, launch timing, maker comments, and launch day steps. It also uses the belt CLI to generate gallery images and search for competitor launches.
summary.zh: 本技能帮助你规划 Product Hunt 产品发布。内容包括列表规格、画廊图片、标语、发布时间、Maker 评论和发布当天的流程。它还能通过 belt CLI 生成画廊图片，并搜索竞品的发布情况。

tagline.en: AI product photography for e-commerce and lifestyle shots
tagline.zh: 用AI生成电商产品图与生活场景图

summary.en: This skill generates product images with AI through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers hero shots, white-background packshots, lifestyle, scale, detail and group shots, with rules for angles, lighting, shadows and backgrounds. It also includes marketplace requirements such as Amazon's white background and frame fill.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具，用AI生成产品图。它覆盖主图、纯白背景棚拍图、生活场景图、尺寸参照图、细节图和组合图，并给出角度、布光、阴影和背景的规则。它还包含亚马逊等平台的要求，例如纯白背景和主体占画面比例。

tagline.en: Run Python code in a sandbox with 100+ libraries
tagline.zh: 在沙箱中运行 Python 代码

summary.en: python-executor runs Python code through the belt CLI in an isolated environment. It includes over 100 libraries, such as pandas, requests, Playwright, Pillow, OpenCV and trimesh. Files saved to outputs/ are returned with the result.
summary.zh: python-executor 通过 belt 命令行工具，在隔离环境中运行 Python 代码。环境内置 100 多个库，包括 pandas、requests、Playwright、Pillow、OpenCV 和 trimesh。保存到 outputs/ 目录的文件会随结果一起返回。

tagline.en: Render MP4 videos from React Remotion component code
tagline.zh: 用 Remotion 组件代码渲染 MP4 视频

summary.en: This skill takes React Remotion component code in TSX and renders it to an MP4 video through the inference.sh CLI (`belt`). You set the duration, frame rate, resolution, and optionally props and codec. It helps when you want to make a video from code instead of editing it by hand.
summary.zh: 这个技能接收 TSX 格式的 React Remotion 组件代码，通过 inference.sh CLI（belt）将其渲染为 MP4 视频。你可以设置时长、帧率、分辨率，还可以按需设置 props 和编码格式。当你想用代码生成视频，而不是手动编辑时，它很有用。

tagline.en: Plan film and video shots as AI-generated storyboard panels
tagline.zh: 用AI生成分镜面板，规划影视镜头

summary.en: This skill guides you through storyboarding for film, video, ads, music videos and animation. It gives you shot types, camera angles, camera movement, continuity rules and a panel annotation format. It also shows how to generate each panel with the inference.sh `belt` CLI and stitch the panels into a board.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于影视、视频、广告、音乐视频和动画的分镜制作。它提供景别、机位角度、运镜、连续性规则和分镜标注格式。它还说明如何用 inference.sh 的 `belt` 命令行工具生成每个分镜画面，并把画面拼成分镜板。

tagline.en: Platform specs and workflow for short video ads
tagline.zh: 按平台规格制作短视频广告的流程

summary.en: video-ad-specs gives exact specs for video ads on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn, including dimensions, duration limits and caption rules. It also gives an AIDA timing plan and commands for generating, voicing, merging and captioning ads with the inference.sh belt CLI.
summary.zh: video-ad-specs 提供 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook 和 LinkedIn 视频广告的具体规格，包括尺寸、时长上限和字幕要求。它还给出 AIDA 时间安排，以及使用 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 生成、配音、合并和加字幕的命令。

tagline.en: Web search and content extraction via the belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 进行网页搜索与内容提取

summary.en: This skill runs web search and URL content extraction through the inference.sh belt CLI. It offers five apps from Tavily and Exa, including AI-generated answers, direct factual answers, and clean text from URLs. It gives a developer a single command-line path to web sources for research and agent workflows.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 执行网页搜索和 URL 内容提取。它提供来自 Tavily 和 Exa 的五个应用，包括 AI 生成的答案、直接的事实性回答以及网页的干净正文。开发者可以在命令行中用同一种方式获取网页来源，用于研究和智能体工作流。

tagline.en: Design and check YouTube thumbnails with AI image generation
tagline.zh: 用 AI 生成并检查 YouTube 缩略图

summary.en: This skill guides YouTube thumbnail design. It gives the required sizes, safe zones, color and text rules, and face expression guidance. It also uses the belt CLI from inference.sh to generate thumbnail images from prompts.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于设计 YouTube 缩略图。它提供尺寸要求、安全区、配色和文字规则，以及人脸表情建议。它还通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI，根据提示词生成缩略图图片。

tagline.en: Drive a real browser over CDP for interactive web tasks
tagline.zh: 通过 CDP 直接操作真实浏览器，完成需要交互的网页任务

summary.en: browser-use gives an agent direct control of a Chrome or Chromium browser through the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). It covers clicks, typing, navigation, logged-in sessions, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, and bot-protected sites. It also covers hosted cloud browsers and the browser-use Python library.
summary.zh: browser-use 让智能体通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol（CDP）直接控制 Chrome 或 Chromium 浏览器。它能处理点击、输入、导航、已登录的会话、需要 JavaScript 渲染的页面、截图，以及有反爬限制的网站。它也支持托管的云端浏览器和 browser-use Python 库。

tagline.en: Raw ad, app, ranking and market data from AdMapix
tagline.zh: AdMapix 原始广告、应用、排行与市场数据

summary.en: This skill is a thin client for the AdMapix read API. It fetches ad creatives, app and developer data, rankings, download and revenue estimates, and market data, and returns them as raw JSON. The calling agent decides which endpoints to call and does any analysis.
summary.zh: 这个技能是 AdMapix 读取接口的轻量客户端。它获取广告素材、应用和开发者数据、排行榜、下载量与收入估算以及市场数据，并以原始 JSON 返回。调用方的智能体决定请求哪些接口，并自行完成分析。

tagline.en: Browser automation for AI agents using element refs
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的无头浏览器自动化

summary.en: This skill lets an AI agent drive a headless browser through the agent-browser CLI. It takes accessibility tree snapshots and selects elements by ref, such as @e2, so each action targets a known element. This makes multi-step browser workflows more predictable.
summary.zh: 这个技能让 AI 智能体通过 agent-browser 命令行工具操作无头浏览器。它读取无障碍树快照，并通过 @e2 这类元素引用来选择页面元素，使每一步操作都指向确定的元素。这样，多步骤的浏览器流程更容易稳定复现。

tagline.en: Persistent memory for agents: facts, lessons, entities
tagline.zh: 为智能体提供持久记忆：事实、经验与实体

summary.en: AgentMemory gives an AI agent a memory that lasts across sessions. It stores facts, records lessons from actions with their outcomes, and tracks people and projects as entities. The agent can search this memory when a new session starts.
summary.zh: AgentMemory 让 AI 智能体的记忆跨会话保留。它可以保存事实，记录每次行动的结果和经验，并把人物和项目作为实体进行跟踪。新会话开始时，智能体可以检索这些记忆。

tagline.en: China insurance needs, product comparison and premiums
tagline.zh: 中国大陆保险需求、产品对比与保费估算

summary.en: This skill helps an agent advise on insurance for people in mainland China. It runs local Python scripts for needs analysis, product comparison, premium estimates and three plan options, and answers questions from local knowledge and compliance notes. It does not handle underwriting pre-checks, claims handling or sales tools.
summary.zh: 本 skill 帮助 agent 为中国大陆的个人和家庭提供保险咨询。它调用本地 Python 脚本完成需求分析、产品对比、保费估算和三套方案设计，并依据本地知识库与合规要点回答问题。它不提供核保预审、理赔代办或代理人展业工具。

tagline.en: Read and write Airtable data through a managed connection
tagline.zh: 通过托管连接读写 Airtable 数据

summary.en: This skill gives an agent access to the Airtable API through the Maton CLI, using managed OAuth. It covers bases, tables, and records, including reads, creates, updates, deletes, and filter-formula queries. It also documents how to turn an Airtable connection into hosted functions and triggers that run on a schedule or on an event.
summary.zh: 该技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 和托管 OAuth 访问 Airtable API。它覆盖多维表格（base）、数据表和记录，包括读取、创建、更新、删除以及使用筛选公式查询。文档还说明了如何把 Airtable 连接用于托管函数和触发器，从而按计划或事件自动运行。

tagline.en: Call connected third-party apps through the Maton gateway
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 网关调用用户已连接的第三方应用

summary.en: The api-gateway skill lets an agent call third-party apps that the user has already connected through Maton. Maton adds the stored credential, so the agent does not handle the app's secret. The skill also covers setting up the maton CLI, managing connections and access policies, and, with explicit approval, hosted functions, triggers and bridges.
summary.zh: api-gateway 技能让智能体通过 Maton 调用用户已在 Maton 中连接的第三方应用。Maton 负责注入该应用的凭据，智能体不直接接触密钥。技能还包括 maton 命令行工具的设置、连接与访问策略的管理，以及在用户明确批准后使用托管函数、触发器和桥接。

tagline.en: Manage Apple Reminders from the terminal on macOS
tagline.zh: 在 macOS 终端中管理提醒事项

summary.en: apple-reminders gives you the remindctl command-line tool for Apple Reminders on macOS. You can list, add, edit, complete and delete reminders, manage lists, and filter by date. Output can be JSON, plain text, or a count, so scripts can read it.
summary.zh: apple-reminders 提供 remindctl 命令行工具，用于在 macOS 上管理提醒事项。你可以列出、添加、编辑、完成和删除提醒，管理列表，并按日期筛选。输出可以是 JSON、纯文本或计数，方便脚本读取。

tagline.en: Asana API access with managed OAuth, via the maton CLI
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 访问 Asana API

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Asana work through the Maton API. It covers tasks, projects, workspaces, users and webhooks, and authenticates with a managed OAuth connection. It can also turn an approved Asana call into a hosted function that a schedule or another app's event runs.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton API 读取和修改 Asana 工作内容，覆盖任务、项目、工作区、用户和 webhook，认证方式为托管的 OAuth 连接。它还可以把用户批准的 Asana 调用做成托管函数，由定时任务或其他应用的事件来触发运行。

tagline.en: Read and manage Attio CRM data through Maton
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 管理 Attio CRM 数据

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or developer work with Attio CRM data through the `maton` CLI. It covers people, companies, custom objects, records, tasks, notes, comments, lists, and meetings. Maton handles the Attio OAuth login, so calls run under the user's connection.
summary.zh: 该技能让智能体或开发者通过 `maton` 命令行工具处理 Attio CRM 数据，涵盖人员、公司、自定义对象、记录、任务、备注、评论、列表和会议。OAuth 登录由 Maton 统一处理，调用均以用户的连接身份执行。

tagline.en: Daily cron job to update Clawdbot and its skills
tagline.zh: 每天通过定时任务更新 Clawdbot 和技能

summary.en: Auto-Updater sets up a daily cron job that updates Clawdbot and all skills, then messages you a summary of what changed. It removes the need to run update commands by hand for Clawdbot and each skill.
summary.zh: Auto-Updater 会设置一个每日定时任务，更新 Clawdbot 和所有技能，然后给你发送一条变更摘要。你不再需要手动为 Clawdbot 和每个技能执行更新命令。

tagline.en: Manage Baidu Drive files and back up agent memory
tagline.zh: 管理百度网盘文件，备份与恢复 Agent 记忆

summary.en: A file manager for Baidu Drive (pan.baidu.com). It covers upload, download, transfer, share, search, move, copy, rename, create folder and delete, with all operations limited to the /apps/bdpan/ folder. On Kimiclaw, MaxClaw, QClaw and OpenClaw it can also back up and restore agent memory files to Baidu Drive.
summary.zh: 百度网盘（pan.baidu.com）文件管理工具，支持上传、下载、转存、分享、搜索、移动、复制、重命名、创建文件夹和删除。所有操作限定在 /apps/bdpan/ 目录内。在 Kimiclaw、MaxClaw、QClaw、OpenClaw 环境中，还可把 Agent 记忆文件备份到网盘或从网盘恢复。

tagline.en: Web search through the Baidu AI Search API
tagline.zh: 通过百度AI搜索接口进行网页搜索

summary.en: baidu-search lets an OpenClaw agent run web searches through the Baidu AI Search Engine (BDSE). It is meant for live information, documentation lookups and research topics. It needs a BAIDU_API_KEY and python3.
summary.zh: baidu-search 让 OpenClaw 智能体通过百度AI搜索引擎（BDSE）执行网页搜索，适用于获取实时信息、查阅文档和研究类问题。使用前需要配置 BAIDU_API_KEY，并安装 python3。

tagline.en: One toolkit for Bilibili hot lists, downloads, subtitles and publishing
tagline.zh: 一套工具处理B站热门榜单、下载、字幕与投稿

summary.en: bilibili-all-in-one is a Python toolkit for Bilibili. It covers hot and ranking lists, video downloads, stats tracking, subtitles, playback info and danmaku, and video publishing. You call it from the command line or from Python code, and each action returns a JSON result.
summary.zh: bilibili-all-in-one 是一个面向 B 站的 Python 工具包。它覆盖热门与排行榜、视频下载、数据统计、字幕、播放信息与弹幕，以及视频投稿。可以通过命令行或 Python 代码调用，每个操作返回 JSON 结果。

tagline.en: Daily email digest of trending Bilibili videos
tagline.zh: B站热门视频日报，邮件发送

summary.en: This skill builds a daily report of trending Bilibili videos and emails it. For each video it can add an AI summary based on the subtitles and an AI comment. The report is sent as an HTML email with the current date in the subject.
summary.zh: 这个 Skill 生成 B站热门视频日报，并以邮件发送。开启 AI 后，每个视频会基于字幕生成总结，并附上 AI 点评。邮件为 HTML 格式，标题自动使用当天日期。

tagline.en: Brave web search, autosuggest, spellcheck, cited answers
tagline.zh: Brave网页搜索、自动补全、拼写检查与带引用回答

summary.en: A skill that gives an agent four tools built on the official Brave Search API: web search, query autosuggest, spellcheck, and AI answers with inline citations. It is meant for looking up documentation, facts, current events, and other web content.
summary.zh: 这是一个为智能体提供四个工具的技能，工具基于 Brave 官方搜索 API，分别用于网页搜索、查询自动补全、拼写检查，以及带行内引用的 AI 回答。适合查文档、核实事实、了解时事和检索其他网页内容。

tagline.en: Web search and page extraction via Brave Search API
tagline.zh: 通过 Brave Search API 进行网页搜索和页面内容提取

summary.en: brave-search runs web searches through the Brave Search API and can pull the readable text of result pages as markdown. It runs from the command line with no browser. It is meant for looking up documentation, facts, and other web content from a script or agent.
summary.zh: brave-search 通过 Brave Search API 执行网页搜索，并可将结果页面的可读正文提取为 Markdown。它从命令行运行，不需要浏览器。适合脚本或智能体查找文档、事实及其他网页内容。

tagline.en: Scheduling data, availability and webhooks for Calendly
tagline.zh: Calendly 日程数据、可用时间与 Webhook 管理

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and manage Calendly data through the Maton CLI, or with raw HTTP and a Maton API key where the CLI cannot be used. It covers event types, scheduled events, invitees, availability and webhook subscriptions. It also explains how a Calendly connection can drive hosted functions and triggers for automation.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 Maton CLI 读取和管理 Calendly 数据；在无法使用 CLI 的情况下，可用 Maton API 密钥发送原始 HTTP 请求。覆盖活动类型、已安排活动、受邀者、可用时间和 Webhook 订阅。文档还说明了如何让 Calendly 连接驱动托管函数和触发器，实现自动化。

tagline.en: Grab snapshots, clips and motion events from cameras
tagline.zh: 从摄像头抓取截图、视频片段和移动事件

summary.en: camsnap captures still frames, short clips, and motion events from RTSP and ONVIF cameras. You register each camera once with a name and login, then refer to it by that name in commands. It is a command line tool that an agent or script can call to get camera output.
summary.zh: camsnap 可从 RTSP 和 ONVIF 摄像头抓取静态画面、短视频片段和移动事件。每个摄像头只需添加一次，并设置名称和登录信息，之后命令中直接使用该名称即可。它是一个命令行工具，智能体或脚本可以调用它获取摄像头输出。

tagline.en: Sub-agent for research, media, documents and code
tagline.zh: 面向研究、多媒体、文档与代码的子代理

summary.en: CellCog is a sub-agent that takes one request and returns several kinds of output. It reads files of many types and can produce research, images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, dashboards, 3D models, diagrams and code. Your agent hands off the task and gets the finished files back.
summary.zh: CellCog 是一个子代理，接收一次请求后可以返回多种类型的产出。它能读取多种格式的文件，生成研究报告、图片、视频、音频、文档、电子表格、仪表盘、3D 模型、图表和代码。你的代理把任务交出去，再取回完成的文件。

tagline.en: Drafts, edits and reviews Chinese official and news documents
tagline.zh: 起草、修改、审核中文公文与新闻稿件

summary.en: This skill helps write, rewrite, shorten, polish and review Chinese official documents, routine administrative materials and news articles. It covers many document types, from requests and reports to notices, resolutions, letters and speeches. It also handles Word layout for official documents.
summary.zh: 本技能用于起草、改写、压缩、润色和审核中文公文、事务性材料及新闻稿件。它覆盖申请、请示、报告、通知、决定、函、批复、纪要、讲话、新闻消息等多种文种。它也能处理公文的 Word 版式。

tagline.en: Place US phone calls for an AI agent
tagline.zh: 让AI代理拨打美国电话

summary.en: clawcall-dev lets an AI agent place real US phone calls for a user. It covers tasks such as calling a business, handling hold or phone menus, and confirming, rescheduling, cancelling, booking, or checking an order. It also manages calling preferences and answers inbound calls on a reserved number.
summary.zh: clawcall-dev 让AI代理代表用户拨打真实的美国电话。它可以用于致电商家、处理等待和语音菜单，也可以确认、改期、取消、预订或查询订单。它还能管理通话偏好，并在保留号码上接听来电。

tagline.en: Search, install, update and publish skills with the ClawdHub CLI
tagline.zh: 用 ClawdHub CLI 搜索、安装、更新和发布技能

summary.en: This skill documents the ClawdHub CLI, a command line tool for finding, installing, updating and publishing agent skills from clawdhub.com. It covers the commands for each of these tasks, plus login and listing installed skills. It is useful when you want to manage skill folders from a terminal instead of by hand.
summary.zh: 这个技能介绍 ClawdHub CLI，这是一个命令行工具，用于从 clawdhub.com 查找、安装、更新和发布智能体技能。文中列出了每项任务的命令，还包括登录和列出已安装技能。如果你希望在终端中管理技能文件夹，而不是手动操作，它会有帮助。

tagline.en: Advisory monitoring and approval-gated response for OpenClaw
tagline.zh: OpenClaw技能安全公告监控与审批式处置

summary.en: clawsec-suite checks the ClawSec advisory feed and compares advisories against the skills you have installed locally. When a malicious or removal-recommended skill matches, it notifies you and recommends removal, but it does not remove anything without your explicit approval. It also acts as the setup entrypoint for other ClawSec protections.
summary.zh: clawsec-suite 会检查 ClawSec 安全公告源，并将公告与本地已安装的技能进行比对。当恶意技能或建议移除的技能命中时，它会通知你并建议移除，但未经你明确批准，它不会删除任何内容。它也是其他 ClawSec 防护的设置入口。

tagline.en: Read and manage ClickUp work items through Maton OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 授权管理 ClickUp 工作项

summary.en: This skill gives an agent access to the ClickUp API through Maton's managed OAuth. It covers tasks, lists, folders, spaces, workspaces, users, and webhooks. Calls run through the `maton` CLI, and each call uses the user's own ClickUp connection.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton 托管的 OAuth 访问 ClickUp API，覆盖任务、列表、文件夹、空间、工作区、用户和 webhook。调用通过 `maton` 命令行工具完成，每次调用都使用用户自己的 ClickUp 连接。

tagline.en: Build, deploy and debug CloudBase (Tencent Cloud) apps
tagline.zh: 为腾讯云开发项目提供开发、部署与排错指引

summary.en: CloudBase is a set of backend services for WeChat Mini Programs and Web/H5 apps, including databases, cloud functions, cloud storage, auth and hosting. This skill guides an AI agent through building, deploying, debugging and migrating CloudBase projects. It sends each task to the matching reference so the agent works from the right rules.
summary.zh: 云开发为微信小程序和 Web/H5 应用提供后端服务，包括数据库、云函数、云存储、身份认证和静态托管。这个技能指导 AI 助手完成云开发项目的开发、部署、排错和迁移。它会把每个任务指向对应的参考文档，让助手按正确的规则工作。

tagline.en: Cournot event probabilities and pricing-divergence rankings
tagline.zh: Cournot事件概率与定价偏离排名

summary.en: This skill queries Cournot for a probability assessment of a specific event claim, and for a ranking of markets whose prices diverge. It also handles prepaid calls, balances and API keys. It runs only when you type /cournot or explicitly ask to use Cournot.
summary.zh: 这个技能会向Cournot查询某个具体事件判断的概率评估，也会查询定价偏离的市场排名。它还管理预付费调用次数、余额和API密钥。只有在你输入/cournot或明确要求使用Cournot时才会运行。

tagline.en: AI drafts for stories, scripts, and world building
tagline.zh: AI辅助创作小说、剧本与世界观

summary.en: Writes and plans fiction with CellCog. It covers short stories, novels, screenplays, fan fiction, and poetry, plus world building and character work. Each task goes to CellCog in creative mode, and the result comes back as a draft.
summary.zh: 通过 CellCog 撰写和规划小说类作品。内容包括短篇小说、长篇小说、剧本、同人小说和诗歌，也支持世界观与角色设计。每个任务都以创意模式发送给 CellCog，并返回一份草稿。

tagline.en: Builds, debugs and hardens Docker images and Compose stacks
tagline.zh: 构建、调试并加固 Docker 镜像与 Compose 栈

summary.en: This skill helps you write, debug, harden and ship Docker containers, images and Compose stacks. It maps common failures to a cause and a fix, such as containers that exit at once, unreachable ports, full disks and builds that never hit the cache. It keeps local notes under ~/Clawic/data/ so known facts and deploy digests carry over between sessions.
summary.zh: 该技能用于编写、调试、加固和交付 Docker 容器、镜像及 Compose 编排。它把常见故障对应到原因和修复方法，例如容器秒退、端口不通、磁盘占满以及构建缓存总不命中。它会把笔记保存在 ~/Clawic/data/ 下，让已确认的事实和部署摘要在后续会话中保留。

tagline.en: Let AI agents work in a running EasyEDA Pro client
tagline.zh: 让AI智能体操作正在运行的嘉立创EDA专业版

summary.en: EasyEDA API skill for AI agents. It gives reference docs for the EasyEDA Pro API and a WebSocket bridge that runs code in the open EasyEDA client. It also covers extension development and document source formats.
summary.zh: 面向AI智能体的嘉立创EDA API技能包。它提供专业版API参考文档，以及一个WebSocket桥接服务，可在已打开的嘉立创EDA客户端中执行代码。技能包同时涵盖扩展开发和文档源文件格式说明。

tagline.en: Build and edit XLSX workbooks without breaking formulas
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑 XLSX 工作簿，保证公式不被破坏

summary.en: This skill helps an agent create, inspect, and edit Excel workbooks and XLSX files. It covers formulas, dates, data types, formatting, recalculation, and keeping existing templates intact. It is aimed at spreadsheets where formulas, dates, or layout must still work after edits.
summary.zh: 这个技能帮助智能体创建、检查和编辑 Excel 工作簿与 XLSX 文件。它涵盖公式、日期、数据类型、格式、重新计算，以及保留现有模板。适用于编辑后公式、日期或版式仍需正确的表格。

tagline.en: Fathom meeting recordings, transcripts and summaries via Maton
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 访问 Fathom 会议录制、转写和摘要

summary.en: The fathom skill gives access to Fathom meeting recordings, transcripts, summaries and action items through the Maton CLI or raw HTTP, using managed OAuth. It can also manage Fathom webhooks for notifications about new meetings. It also documents how to turn a Fathom call into a hosted function and a schedule or event trigger.
summary.zh: fathom 技能通过 Maton CLI 或原始 HTTP 访问 Fathom 的会议录制、转写、摘要和待办事项，使用托管的 OAuth 认证。它还可以管理 Fathom 的 webhook，用于接收新会议的通知。文档同时说明了如何把一次 Fathom 调用变成托管函数，并由定时或事件触发器自动执行。

tagline.en: Find OpenClaw skills by task, provider or category
tagline.zh: 按任务、服务或类别查找OpenClaw技能

summary.en: This skill searches for OpenClaw skills. It runs keyword searches and category browsing on ClawHub, and it lists other places to look, such as the OpenClaw Directory, LobeHub, and GitHub. It also points to other skills for managing installed skills and creating new ones.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于查找OpenClaw技能。它可以在ClawHub上按关键词搜索，也可以按类别浏览，并列出其他可查找的地方，例如OpenClaw Directory、LobeHub和GitHub。对于已设置的技能管理和新技能创建，它会指向对应的其他技能。

tagline.en: Sets OpenClaw to free OpenRouter models with fallbacks
tagline.zh: 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 免费模型并配置备用

summary.en: FreeRide configures OpenClaw to use free AI models from OpenRouter. It ranks the free models, sets the best one as the primary model, and adds ranked fallbacks so that rate limits do not stop the user. It updates only the model keys in openclaw.json and keeps the rest of the config as it is.
summary.zh: FreeRide 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 上的免费 AI 模型。它会对免费模型排序，把最好的一个设为主模型，并添加有序的备用模型，使速率限制不会打断用户。它只更新 openclaw.json 中的模型相关字段，其余配置保持不变。

tagline.en: One-shot Gemini CLI prompts for Q&A and generation
tagline.zh: 用一次性提示调用 Gemini CLI 完成问答与生成

summary.en: This skill lets an agent run the Gemini CLI in one-shot mode. It sends a single prompt and reads the reply for questions, summaries, and text generation. It covers model choice, JSON output, and the extensions command.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体以一次性模式运行 Gemini CLI。它发送一个提示，读取一个回复，用于问答、摘要和文本生成。内容包括模型选择、JSON 输出和扩展命令。

tagline.en: Manage your GetNote notes via the official getnote CLI
tagline.zh: 通过官方 getnote CLI 管理得到笔记

summary.en: This skill lets your AI assistant save, find, read and organize notes in your GetNote account. It runs the official getnote CLI for each action and checks the real result before it reports success. It also handles browser login, connection checks and CLI upgrades.
summary.zh: 本 Skill 让 AI 助手在你的得到大脑账号中保存、查找、阅读和整理笔记。每个操作都通过官方 getnote CLI 执行，并在报告成功前检查真实结果。它还负责浏览器授权、连接诊断和 CLI 升级。

tagline.en: Search GIFs from Tenor or Giphy, then extract stills
tagline.zh: 搜索 Tenor 和 Giphy 的 GIF，并提取静帧

summary.en: gifgrep is a command-line tool and TUI for searching the Tenor and Giphy GIF providers. It shows previews, saves chosen results to ~/Downloads, and extracts a single still frame or a PNG grid of sampled frames from a GIF. It helps when you need a quick visual of a GIF for review, docs, or chat.
summary.zh: gifgrep 是一个命令行工具和 TUI，用于搜索 Tenor 和 Giphy 两个 GIF 服务。它可以预览结果，把选中的结果保存到 ~/Downloads，也可以从 GIF 中提取单张静帧或由多帧组成的 PNG 网格。需要快速查看 GIF 内容用于评审、文档或聊天时，它能派上用场。

tagline.en: Work with GitHub issues, PRs, CI runs and API via gh
tagline.zh: 用 gh 处理 GitHub 议题、PR、CI 运行和 API

summary.en: This skill tells an agent how to use the `gh` CLI to work with GitHub. It covers issues, pull requests, workflow runs, and the `gh api` command for data the other subcommands do not reach. It shows commands for checking CI, reading failed step logs, and filtering output with `--json` and `--jq`.
summary.zh: 这个技能教代理如何使用 `gh` 命令行工具操作 GitHub。内容包括议题、拉取请求、工作流运行，以及用于获取其他子命令无法提供的数据的 `gh api`。文档给出了查看 CI 状态、读取失败步骤日志，以及用 `--json` 和 `--jq` 筛选输出的命令。

tagline.en: Work with GitHub repos, issues and PRs through Maton
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 读写 GitHub 仓库与拉取请求

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the GitHub REST API through the Maton CLI. Maton handles OAuth, so the user signs in once and does not paste a GitHub token into the agent. It covers repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, branches, users and code search.
summary.zh: 这个技能让代理通过 Maton CLI 调用 GitHub REST API。授权由 Maton 通过 OAuth 完成，用户登录一次即可，无需把 GitHub 令牌交给代理。它覆盖仓库、Issue、拉取请求、提交、分支、用户和代码搜索。

tagline.en: Read and manage Gmail through Maton's managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 托管授权读写 Gmail

summary.en: This skill gives an agent or developer access to the Gmail API through the `maton` CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key where the CLI cannot be installed. It covers reading, sending and managing emails, threads, labels and drafts. Maton handles the OAuth login and token renewal, so you do not build that flow yourself.
summary.zh: 这个 skill 让智能体或开发者通过 `maton` 命令行访问 Gmail API。在无法安装命令行的环境中，也可以用 Maton API 密钥直接发送 HTTP 请求。它支持读取、发送和管理邮件、会话、标签和草稿。OAuth 登录与令牌续期由 Maton 处理，你不必自己实现这套授权流程。

tagline.en: Command-line access to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets and Docs
tagline.zh: 在命令行中访问 Gmail、日历、云端硬盘、表格和文档

summary.en: gog is a command-line tool for Google Workspace. It lets you search and send Gmail, read and list Calendar events, search Drive, list Contacts, and read, write and clear Google Sheets ranges. It also exports and reads Google Docs. It needs a one-time OAuth setup before use.
summary.zh: gog 是一个用于 Google Workspace 的命令行工具。它可以搜索和发送 Gmail，读取日历事件，搜索云端硬盘，列出通讯录，以及读取、写入和清空 Google 表格区域。它还能导出和读取 Google 文档。使用前需要完成一次 OAuth 设置。

tagline.en: Read and manage Google Analytics through Maton OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton OAuth 访问 Google Analytics

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Google Analytics Admin API and Data API through a Maton connection that handles OAuth. The Data API runs reports on sessions, users, page views and conversions. The Admin API can create, update and delete accounts, properties and data streams, so those writes need explicit user approval.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton 连接调用 Google Analytics 的 Admin API 和 Data API，OAuth 授权由 Maton 管理。Data API 可以查询会话、用户、页面浏览和转化数据。Admin API 可以创建、更新和删除账户、资源和数据流，因此这些写操作都需要用户明确批准。

tagline.en: Google Calendar access via Maton with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 托管 OAuth 访问 Google 日历

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or developer list calendars, list and create events, check availability, and manage schedules in Google Calendar through the `maton` CLI. It also documents how to turn a Google Calendar connection into automation with hosted functions and triggers. It removes the need to build Google OAuth login, token storage and renewal in your own code.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体或开发者通过 `maton` 命令行工具列出日历、查询和创建日程、检查空闲时间，并管理 Google 日历中的安排。它还说明了如何用托管函数和触发器，把 Google 日历连接变成自动化流程。你不必在自己的代码里实现 Google 的 OAuth 登录、令牌存储和续期。

tagline.en: Create and edit Google Docs with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 用托管 OAuth 操作 Google 文档

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or developer call the Google Docs API through the `maton` CLI. It can create documents, insert text, apply formatting and manage content. Authentication is handled by Maton's managed OAuth, so the user does not manage Google tokens directly.
summary.zh: 这个 skill 让智能体或开发者通过 `maton` CLI 调用 Google Docs API。它可以创建文档、插入文字、设置格式并管理文档内容。身份验证由 Maton 的托管 OAuth 完成，用户不需要自己处理 Google 的令牌。

tagline.en: Google Play Developer API calls with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 调用 Google Play 开发者 API

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Google Play Developer API (Android Publisher) through the maton CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key. OAuth is managed by Maton, so the user does not handle Google tokens directly. It covers apps, subscriptions, in-app purchases and reviews, and can turn a Google Play read into a scheduled hosted function.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 maton CLI 调用 Google Play 开发者 API（Android Publisher），也可以用 Maton API Key 直接发送 HTTP 请求。OAuth 由 Maton 托管，用户不需要自己处理 Google 令牌。它覆盖应用、订阅、应用内商品和评论，还能把一次 Google Play 读取变成按计划运行的托管函数。

tagline.en: Admin SDK access to Google Workspace users and settings
tagline.zh: 通过 Admin SDK 管理 Google Workspace 用户与设置

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Google Workspace users, groups, organizational units, roles, and domain settings through the Admin SDK. It uses managed OAuth and the `maton` CLI, so the user does not handle raw Google credentials. Reads run by default, and every write needs the user's explicit approval.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Admin SDK 读取和修改 Google Workspace 的用户、群组、组织单位、角色和域设置。它使用托管 OAuth 和 `maton` 命令行工具，用户无需自己处理原始的 Google 凭据。默认只执行读取和列出操作，每一次写入都需要用户明确批准。

tagline.en: Google Places lookup from the command line
tagline.zh: 命令行查询 Google 地点信息

summary.en: goplaces is a command-line tool for the Google Places API (New). It runs text searches, place details, place resolution, and review lookups. It prints readable output by default and JSON with a flag for scripts.
summary.zh: goplaces 是一个用于 Google Places API（New）的命令行工具，支持文本搜索、地点详情、地点解析和评论查询。默认输出便于阅读的内容，加上参数后可输出 JSON，方便脚本处理。

tagline.en: Inspect and operate an existing Home Assistant setup
tagline.zh: 检查并操作现有 Home Assistant 安装

summary.en: Lets an agent inspect, troubleshoot and operate an existing Home Assistant installation through its REST API and an optional WebSocket reader. It covers entity states, action schemas, device and entity registries, Assist, automations, calendars, energy statistics and diagnostics. It also sets safety rules for locks, alarm panels, garage doors and access covers.
summary.zh: 让代理通过 REST API 和可选的 WebSocket 读取器，检查、排查并操作现有的 Home Assistant 安装。覆盖实体状态、动作模式、设备与实体注册表、Assist、自动化、日历、能源统计和诊断。同时为门锁、报警面板、车库门和出入口遮挡设置了安全规则。

tagline.en: Edits text to remove common AI writing patterns
tagline.zh: 去除文本中常见的AI写作痕迹

summary.en: Humanizer is a writing editor for text that sounds like it was generated by AI. It finds patterns such as inflated wording, vague attributions, stock phrases, em dash overuse, and overused groups of three. It rewrites those sections so the text reads more direct and specific, while keeping the original meaning and tone.
summary.zh: Humanizer 是一个文本编辑技能，用于处理看起来像 AI 生成的文字。它会找出夸大措辞、模糊的出处、套话、过多的破折号以及滥用的三项并列等写法。改写后，文字会更直接、更具体，同时保留原意和语气。

tagline.en: AI image generation and editing through CellCog
tagline.zh: 通过 CellCog 生成和编辑 AI 图像

summary.en: This skill generates and edits images with AI through CellCog. You describe the image in a text prompt, or pass an existing image to edit or use as a reference. It covers single images, consistent characters across a set, product shots, and campaign image sets.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 CellCog 用 AI 生成和编辑图像。你可以用文字描述想要的画面，也可以传入已有图片进行编辑或作为参考。它适用于单张图片、跨多张图保持角色一致、产品图以及营销图片组。

tagline.en: Read, search and send email over IMAP and SMTP
tagline.zh: 用 IMAP/SMTP 读取、搜索和发送邮件

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read, search and manage email through IMAP, and send mail through SMTP. It works with Gmail, Outlook, several NetEase and QQ domains, and any standard IMAP/SMTP server. It supports multiple accounts and attachments, and it requires Node and npm.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 IMAP 读取、搜索和管理邮件，通过 SMTP 发送邮件。它支持 Gmail、Outlook、网易系多个域名、QQ 邮箱以及任何标准的 IMAP/SMTP 服务器。它支持多账号和附件，运行需要 Node 和 npm。

tagline.en: Read and send iMessage and SMS from the command line
tagline.zh: 用命令行收发 iMessage 和短信

summary.en: imsg is a command-line tool for macOS that works with Messages.app. It lists chats, reads message history, watches a chat for new messages, and sends text and files over iMessage or SMS. It lets you handle Messages from a terminal or from an agent instead of the Messages window.
summary.zh: imsg 是一个在 macOS 上运行的命令行工具，配合“信息”App 使用。它可以列出会话、读取消息记录、监听某个会话的新消息，并通过 iMessage 或短信发送文字和文件。你可以在终端或智能体中处理消息，无需打开“信息”窗口。

tagline.en: Insurance needs analysis, product comparison and plan design
tagline.zh: 中国大陆保险需求分析、产品对比与方案设计

summary.en: This skill helps individuals and families in mainland China plan insurance. It analyzes coverage gaps for death, critical illness, accident and hospitalization risks, compares products, estimates premiums, and builds three plan options. At runtime it reads only the bundled product, knowledge and compliance files and runs three local Python scripts.
summary.zh: 本 skill 面向中国大陆的个人和家庭，提供保险需求分析、产品对比、保费估算和方案设计。它分析身故、大病、意外和住院四类风险的保障缺口，并给出三套方案。运行时只读取随包附带的产品、知识和合规文件，并调用三个本地 Python 脚本。

tagline.en: Klaviyo API access through Maton, with user-approved writes
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 访问 Klaviyo API，写操作需确认

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Klaviyo API through the Maton CLI. It covers profiles, lists, segments, campaigns, flows, events, metrics, templates, catalogs, webhooks and account settings. It also covers hosted functions and triggers that run Klaviyo actions on a schedule or on an event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让代理通过 Maton CLI 调用 Klaviyo API，涵盖用户档案、列表、分群、营销活动、流程、事件、指标、模板、商品目录、Webhook 和账户设置。它还包括托管函数和触发器，可按计划或事件执行 Klaviyo 操作。

tagline.en: LinkedIn API access with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 访问 LinkedIn API

summary.en: This skill lets an AI agent call the LinkedIn API through the Maton CLI, using a managed OAuth connection. It covers sharing posts, reading profile and organization information, uploading media, and advertising features. Every call runs as the user's connection and is limited to what that connection's authorization allows.
summary.zh: 这个技能让 AI 代理通过 Maton CLI 调用 LinkedIn API，授权由托管的 OAuth 连接完成。它支持发布帖子、读取个人资料和组织信息、上传媒体，以及广告相关功能。每次调用都以用户的连接身份执行，且只能访问该连接被授权的范围。

tagline.en: Mailchimp Marketing API access with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 管理 Mailchimp 邮件营销

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and manage Mailchimp data through the Maton CLI, including audiences, campaigns, templates, automations, reports and subscribers. Maton handles OAuth, and every call runs under the user's connection, limited to the endpoints that connection is allowed to use. It also covers hosted functions and triggers for running Mailchimp actions on a schedule or on another app's event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 读取和管理 Mailchimp 数据，包括受众、营销活动、模板、自动化、报告和订阅者。OAuth 由 Maton 托管。每次调用都以用户的连接身份运行，只能访问该连接被允许使用的接口。它还提供托管函数和触发器，可按计划或其他应用的事件运行 Mailchimp 操作。

tagline.en: Convert documents and media files to Markdown
tagline.zh: 将文档和媒体文件转换为 Markdown

summary.en: This skill converts files such as PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, images, audio, ZIP archives, YouTube URLs and EPub into Markdown. It runs the markitdown tool through uvx. The output is meant for LLM processing or text analysis, and it keeps headings, tables, lists and links.
summary.zh: 该技能使用 uvx 运行 markitdown，把 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、HTML、图片、音频、ZIP 压缩包、YouTube 链接和 EPub 等文件转换为 Markdown。输出用于 LLM 处理或文本分析，并保留标题、表格、列表和链接。

tagline.en: Run and manage MCP servers and tools from the terminal
tagline.zh: 在命令行中调用和管理 MCP 服务与工具

summary.en: mcporter is a command-line tool for working with MCP servers directly. It lists servers and tools, calls tools over HTTP or stdio, handles OAuth, and edits config. It can also generate CLI and TypeScript code from a server.
summary.zh: mcporter 是一个直接操作 MCP 服务的命令行工具。它可以列出服务和工具、通过 HTTP 或 stdio 调用工具、完成 OAuth 认证、编辑配置，还能从服务生成 CLI 和 TypeScript 代码。

tagline.en: Set up persistent memory search for Moltbot/Clawdbot
tagline.zh: 为 Moltbot/Clawdbot 配置持久记忆搜索

summary.en: This skill sets up memory search for Moltbot and Clawdbot agents. It covers the config block, a workspace layout with MEMORY.md and daily logs, and agent instructions for recalling stored context. It helps an agent answer questions about past work instead of starting from nothing each session.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于为 Moltbot 和 Clawdbot 的智能体配置记忆搜索。它包括配置项、带有 MEMORY.md 和每日日志的工作区结构，以及让智能体调用已存储上下文的指令。配置后，智能体回答关于过往工作的问题时，不必每次从零开始。

tagline.en: Read and write Excel workbooks in OneDrive and SharePoint
tagline.zh: 读写 OneDrive 与 SharePoint 中的 Excel 工作簿

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Excel workbooks, worksheets, ranges, tables, and charts through the Microsoft Graph API. It uses managed OAuth through the `maton` CLI, so the user does not handle tokens directly. It can also run Excel actions as hosted functions on a schedule or on an event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Microsoft Graph API 读取和修改 Excel 工作簿、工作表、区域、表格和图表。它通过 `maton` 命令行工具使用托管的 OAuth 授权，用户无需自己处理令牌。它还可以把 Excel 操作部署为托管函数，按计划或事件触发运行。

tagline.en: Security guard for OpenClaw agents against prompt injection
tagline.zh: 为 OpenClaw 智能体防护提示注入与数据泄露

summary.en: MoltGuard is a security plugin for OpenClaw agents. It checks for prompt injection, data exfiltration, and malicious commands hidden in files and web content. Detection runs on Core, the OpenGuardrails service.
summary.zh: MoltGuard 是一个面向 OpenClaw 智能体的安全插件。它检查文件和网页内容中隐藏的提示注入、数据外泄和恶意命令。检测由 OpenGuardrails 的 Core 服务完成。

tagline.en: Monday.com boards, items and workspaces over GraphQL
tagline.zh: 通过 GraphQL 管理 Monday.com 看板与任务

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or developer call the Monday.com GraphQL API through a Maton connection. Authentication is handled by managed OAuth, so the user does not manage tokens. It also covers hosted functions and triggers, which can run a Monday.com action on a schedule or on another app's event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体或开发者通过 Maton 连接调用 Monday.com 的 GraphQL API。授权由托管的 OAuth 完成，用户不需要自己管理令牌。它还涵盖托管函数和触发器，可以在定时或其他应用的事件发生时执行一个 Monday.com 操作。

tagline.en: Check and control a Tesla from macOS via the Owner API
tagline.zh: 在 macOS 上通过 Owner API 查看并控制特斯拉

summary.en: My Tesla is a command-line skill for macOS that reads and controls Tesla vehicles through the Tesla Owner API, using teslapy. It covers status, lock and unlock, climate, charging, location, tire pressure, openings, seats, Sentry Mode and mileage logging. Disruptive actions need an explicit --yes flag, and output can be a short chat-friendly summary or sanitized JSON.
summary.zh: My Tesla 是一个运行在 macOS 上的命令行技能，使用 teslapy 通过 Tesla Owner API 读取和控制特斯拉车辆。它支持车辆状态、锁车解锁、空调、充电、位置、胎压、车门车窗、座椅加热、哨兵模式和里程记录。会改变车辆状态的操作需要显式加 --yes 才会执行，输出可以是适合聊天的简短摘要，也可以是脱敏后的 JSON。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with Nano Banana Pro
tagline.zh: 用 Nano Banana Pro 生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs a script that creates new images from a text prompt or edits an existing image with a prompt. It uses Google's Nano Banana Pro API (Gemini 3 Pro Image) and supports 1K, 2K and 4K output. It saves the result as a PNG in the directory where you run it.
summary.zh: 这个技能运行一个脚本，可根据文字提示生成新图片，也可根据提示编辑已有图片。它调用 Google 的 Nano Banana Pro API（Gemini 3 Pro Image），支持 1K、2K 和 4K 输出。结果以 PNG 格式保存在运行命令时所在的目录中。

tagline.en: Edit one PDF page with a plain-language instruction
tagline.zh: 用自然语言指令编辑 PDF 的单个页面

summary.en: nano-pdf is a command-line tool for changing a PDF from a short natural-language instruction. You name the file, the page, and what to change. It applies the edit to that page.
summary.zh: nano-pdf 是一个命令行工具，用简短的自然语言指令修改 PDF。你指定文件、页码和要改的内容，工具会把修改应用到该页。它解决的问题是：不用打开 PDF 编辑器、手动找到文字位置，也能快速改掉标题、错别字或某句文字。

tagline.en: Persistent associative memory for AI agent sessions
tagline.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供跨会话的关联式持久记忆

summary.en: NeuralMemory is a local memory store for AI agents. It keeps facts, decisions, errors and preferences in a graph and recalls them by spreading activation rather than keyword or vector search. It helps an agent pick up past context across sessions.
summary.zh: NeuralMemory 是一个供 AI 智能体使用的本地记忆系统。它把事实、决策、错误和偏好保存在图结构中，通过扩散激活而不是关键词或向量搜索来召回。智能体因此能在不同会话之间接续过去的上下文。

tagline.en: Manage Notion pages, databases and blocks through the API
tagline.zh: 通过 API 管理 Notion 页面、数据库和块

summary.en: This skill gives you Notion API calls for pages, databases and blocks. It covers setup, authentication, the required Notion-Version header and common reads and writes. It also explains the 2025-09-03 change, where databases become data sources with two IDs.
summary.zh: 这个技能提供一组 Notion API 调用示例，用于操作页面、数据库和块。内容包括初始配置、认证方式、必需的 Notion-Version 请求头，以及常见的读取和写入操作。它还说明了 2025-09-03 版本的变化：数据库改称数据源，并拆分出两个 ID。

tagline.en: Query Notion databases and pages through managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 查询 Notion 数据库和页面

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Notion API through the maton CLI, using managed OAuth. It can query databases, search pages and read workspace content. Write operations need explicit user confirmation of the target resource and connection.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 maton CLI 调用 Notion API，并使用托管 OAuth 完成授权。它可以查询数据库、搜索页面并读取工作区内容。任何写入操作都需要用户明确确认目标资源和连接。

tagline.en: Read, search and edit Obsidian vaults from the command line
tagline.zh: 从命令行读取、搜索和编辑 Obsidian 库

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or script work with Obsidian vaults. A vault is a normal folder of Markdown notes, and the skill uses the obsidian-cli tool to search, create, move and delete notes. Moving a note also updates the links that point to it.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体或脚本能够操作 Obsidian 笔记库。笔记库就是一个普通的 Markdown 笔记文件夹。技能通过 obsidian-cli 搜索、创建、移动和删除笔记。移动笔记时，指向它的链接也会一并更新。

tagline.en: Typed knowledge graph for agent memory and shared state
tagline.zh: 面向智能体记忆与共享状态的类型化知识图谱

summary.en: Ontology stores an agent's knowledge as typed entities, such as Person, Project, Task and Event, linked by typed relations. Each write is checked against type constraints before it is saved. Other skills can read and write the same objects, so they share state.
summary.zh: Ontology 把智能体的知识保存为带类型的实体，例如 Person、Project、Task 和 Event，实体之间通过带类型的关系相连。每次写入在保存前都会按类型约束检查。其他技能可以读写同一批对象，从而共享状态。

tagline.en: Local speech-to-text from the command line with Whisper
tagline.zh: 在命令行中用 Whisper 本地转写语音

summary.en: This skill runs OpenAI Whisper through the `whisper` CLI to transcribe audio on your own machine. It does not need an API key. It can write plain text or SRT output, and it can run the translate task on speech.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 `whisper` 命令行工具运行 OpenAI Whisper，在本机转写音频。无需 API 密钥。可输出纯文本或 SRT 字幕，也可对语音执行翻译任务。

tagline.en: Transcribe audio files with OpenAI's Whisper API
tagline.zh: 用 OpenAI Whisper API 转写音频文件

summary.en: This skill sends an audio file to OpenAI's audio transcriptions endpoint using curl and writes the text to a file. It is a wrapper around one script, `transcribe.sh`, that supports a few flags for language, prompt, model, and JSON output.
summary.zh: 这个技能使用 curl 把音频文件发送到 OpenAI 的音频转写接口，并把文字结果写入文件。它是对一个脚本 `transcribe.sh` 的封装，支持语言、提示词、模型和 JSON 输出等参数。

tagline.en: Web search through Tavily, returning URLs and snippets
tagline.zh: 通过 Tavily 搜索公开网页，返回链接和摘要

summary.en: This skill runs a bundled Python script that searches the public web through Tavily. It returns structured results with titles, URLs and snippets, which an agent can use to find current sources. It is also a fallback when the built-in web search is unavailable.
summary.zh: 这个技能会运行随附的 Python 脚本，通过 Tavily 搜索公开网页。它返回带标题、链接和摘要的结构化结果，帮助智能体找到最新的信息来源。当内置的网页搜索不可用时，它也可以作为备用方案。

tagline.en: Finds likely token waste in OpenClaw or Hermes setups
tagline.zh: 查找 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 中可能的 token 浪费

summary.en: This skill audits an OpenClaw or Hermes Agent setup for token waste. It checks instruction size, scheduled tasks and model choices, then explains what matters and what to test next. It only reads and recommends, and it does not change settings.
summary.zh: 这个技能会检查 OpenClaw 或 Hermes Agent 的配置，查找可能的 token 浪费。它会检查指令大小、定时任务和模型选择，然后说明哪些问题值得关注，以及下一步可以测试什么。它只读取和给出建议，不会修改任何设置。

tagline.en: Twitter/X and meme token data from the 6551 API
tagline.zh: 6551 API 的推特与 Meme 代币数据查询

summary.en: This skill queries Twitter/X data and meme token evidence through the 6551 platform REST API. It covers user profiles, tweet search, user tweets, follower events, deleted tweets, KOL followers, and meme token activity. It also includes a WebSocket feed for real-time events from accounts on your watch list.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 6551 平台 REST API 查询推特/X 数据和 Meme 代币证据。覆盖用户资料、推文搜索、用户推文、关注者变动、已删除推文、KOL 关注者和 Meme 代币活动。它还提供 WebSocket 通道，实时推送监控账号的事件。

tagline.en: Send a prompt and files to a second model for review
tagline.zh: 把提示词和文件发给第二个模型审查

summary.en: Oracle is a CLI (@steipete/oracle) that bundles a prompt with selected repo files and sends them to another model. It can run through the API or through browser automation in ChatGPT. This skill covers how to pick the files, preview the bundle before sending, and recover long browser sessions.
summary.zh: Oracle 是一个命令行工具（@steipete/oracle），把提示词和选定的代码文件打包，发送给另一个模型。它可以通过 API 调用，也可以通过浏览器自动化在 ChatGPT 中运行。本技能说明如何挑选文件、在发送前预览打包内容，以及如何恢复耗时较长的浏览器会话。

tagline.en: Outlook mail, calendar and contacts via Microsoft Graph
tagline.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 管理 Outlook 邮件、日程与联系人

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read, send and manage Outlook email, folders, calendar events and contacts through Microsoft Graph. It uses managed OAuth through the `maton` CLI, so the user does not handle tokens directly. It also covers turning an Outlook connection into hosted functions and triggers that run on a schedule or on another app's event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Microsoft Graph 读取、发送和管理 Outlook 邮件、文件夹、日历事件和联系人。它通过 `maton` 命令行工具使用托管的 OAuth 授权，用户不需要直接处理令牌。它还支持把 Outlook 连接用于托管函数和触发器，按定时或其他应用的事件自动运行。

tagline.en: Structured Markdown and JSON from PDFs and document images
tagline.zh: 从 PDF 与文档图片中提取结构化 Markdown 和 JSON

summary.en: This skill runs PaddleOCR document parsing through the paddleocr CLI. It turns PDFs and document images into structured Markdown and JSON, including tables, formulas, figures, seals, charts, and reading order. It is meant for documents where plain OCR loses the layout.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 paddleocr 命令行调用 PaddleOCR 文档解析，将 PDF 和文档图片转换为结构化的 Markdown 与 JSON，涵盖表格、公式、图表、印章和阅读顺序。它面向普通 OCR 会丢失版面结构的文档。

tagline.en: Automate and capture macOS UI from the command line
tagline.zh: 从命令行捕获并自动化 macOS 界面

summary.en: Peekaboo is a macOS command-line tool for capturing screens and driving UI. It can find UI elements, click, type, scroll, and manage apps, windows, menus, and the Dock. Commands support JSON output, so you can script them.
summary.zh: Peekaboo 是一个 macOS 命令行工具，用于捕获屏幕并操作界面。它可以查找界面元素，执行点击、输入、滚动，并管理应用、窗口、菜单和程序坞。命令支持 JSON 输出，便于编写脚本。

tagline.en: Disk-based planning files for multi-step AI agent work
tagline.zh: 面向多步骤智能体任务的磁盘规划文件

summary.en: planning-with-files keeps a task's plan, findings, and progress in markdown files on disk, so an AI agent can work across many tool calls without relying on its context window. Lifecycle hooks inject the selected plan's context while the agent works. The skill has no network upload path, and it reads session history only when the user explicitly asks.
summary.zh: planning-with-files 把任务的计划、发现和进度记录在磁盘上的 Markdown 文件里，让 AI 智能体在多次工具调用中不必依赖上下文窗口保存状态。生命周期钩子会在工作过程中注入所选计划的上下文。该技能没有网络上传路径，只有在用户明确要求时才会读取会话历史。

tagline.en: Phone calls and incoming call answering for AI agents
tagline.zh: 为AI代理提供电话外呼与来电接听

summary.en: PollyReach gives an AI agent its own phone number. The agent can make calls for a human to book, inquire, complain, or confirm, and it can answer incoming calls and send summaries back. It is for tasks that need a phone call, not text or email.
summary.zh: PollyReach为AI代理分配一个专属电话号码。代理可以替用户打电话办事，例如预订、咨询、投诉或确认，也可以接听来电并把摘要发给用户。它适用于必须通过电话完成的任务，而不是文字或邮件能解决的事。

tagline.en: Trade Polymarket temperature markets on forecast data
tagline.zh: 用天气预报交易 Polymarket 温度盘口

summary.en: A Python skill that trades Polymarket temperature bucket markets using NOAA forecasts for US cities and Open-Meteo forecasts for international cities, through the Simmer API. It scans configured locations, compares forecasts with market prices, and places bets within set limits. It runs in dry-run mode unless you pass `--live`.
summary.zh: 这是一个 Python 技能，通过 Simmer API 交易 Polymarket 的温度分段盘口。美国城市使用 NOAA 预报，国际城市使用 Open-Meteo 预报。它会扫描设定的城市，比较预报与市场价格，并在设定的限额内下单。除非传入 `--live`，否则只运行模拟模式。

tagline.en: Build and edit PPTX decks with templates and visual QA
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑PPTX，支持模板与视觉检查

summary.en: This skill helps an agent create, inspect, and edit Microsoft PowerPoint .pptx decks. It covers layouts, placeholders, speaker notes, comments, charts, and template fidelity. It also sets a QA pass so the deck renders cleanly after edits.
summary.zh: 该技能帮助代理创建、检查和编辑 Microsoft PowerPoint 的 .pptx 演示文稿。内容涵盖版式、占位符、演讲者备注、批注、图表和模板一致性。编辑后，它还会做质量检查，确保演示文稿渲染正常。

tagline.en: Patterns for proactive work and context-loss recovery
tagline.zh: 主动工作与上下文丢失后的恢复模式

summary.en: Proactive Agent is a set of patterns and file templates for AI agents. It covers writing key details to disk, recovering after context is truncated, designing cron jobs, and limits on how the agent changes its own rules. It aims to make an agent act on likely needs and keep its state across sessions.
summary.zh: Proactive Agent 是一套面向 AI 智能体的模式和文件模板。它涵盖把关键细节写入磁盘、上下文被截断后的恢复、定时任务的设计，以及对智能体自我修改规则的限制。它的目标是让智能体在用户开口前处理可能需要的事，并在多次会话之间保持状态。

tagline.en: Offline prompt injection and agent security scanner
tagline.zh: 离线检测AI智能体提示注入与安全风险

summary.en: Prompt Guard is a runtime security scanner for AI agents. It checks input and LLM output against 650+ bundled patterns and can run fully offline. It flags attacks such as prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and memory poisoning, then returns an action for the agent to take.
summary.zh: Prompt Guard 是面向 AI 智能体的运行时安全扫描工具。它使用 650 多条内置规则检查输入和模型输出，可以完全离线运行。它能识别提示注入、凭据外泄、记忆投毒等攻击，并返回智能体应采取的处理动作。

tagline.en: ElevenLabs text-to-speech CLI with local playback
tagline.zh: 基于 ElevenLabs 的命令行语音合成，支持本地播放

summary.en: sag is a command-line tool for ElevenLabs text-to-speech. It speaks text aloud with local playback, and it can also write the audio to a file. It uses a say-style interface, so a short command is enough to produce speech.
summary.zh: sag 是一个 ElevenLabs 文本转语音的命令行工具，使用类似 macOS say 的操作方式。它可以在本地播放合成的语音，也可以把音频保存为文件。一条命令即可把文字转成语音。

tagline.en: Salesforce CRM API access with approval on every write
tagline.zh: Salesforce CRM 接口访问，写操作需逐项确认

summary.en: This skill lets an agent query and change Salesforce CRM data through the `maton` CLI, using a managed OAuth connection to the user's Salesforce account. It also covers the hosted functions and triggers that turn a Salesforce call into a scheduled or event-driven task.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 `maton` 命令行工具查询和修改 Salesforce CRM 数据，经由托管的 OAuth 连接访问用户自己的 Salesforce 账户。它还提供托管函数和触发器，可把 Salesforce 操作变成定时或由事件驱动的任务。

tagline.en: Web scraping with HTTP, stealth browsers and spiders
tagline.zh: 网页抓取：HTTP、隐身浏览器与爬虫

summary.en: Scrapling is a Python framework and CLI for scraping and crawling websites. It supports plain HTTP requests, stealth browsers with JavaScript rendering, and concurrent spiders. Its parser can relocate elements when a page changes.
summary.zh: Scrapling 是一个 Python 框架和命令行工具，用于抓取网页和爬取整站。它支持普通 HTTP 请求、带 JavaScript 渲染的隐身浏览器，以及并发爬虫。页面结构变化时，它的解析器可以重新定位元素。

tagline.en: Logs corrections and reflections into local memory tiers
tagline.zh: 记录纠正与反思，分层保存本地记忆

summary.en: This skill lets an agent review its own work and record what it learns. Corrections, explicit preferences and self-reflection notes are stored in local files under ~/self-improving/. Stored patterns move between hot, warm and cold tiers based on how often they are used.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体回顾自己的工作，并记录它学到的内容。用户纠正、明确的偏好和自我反思的记录都保存在 ~/self-improving/ 下的本地文件中。已保存的规律会根据使用频率在热、温、冷三层之间移动。

tagline.en: Logs errors, corrections and learnings for OpenClaw agents
tagline.zh: 为 OpenClaw 智能体记录错误、纠正与经验

summary.en: This skill gives an OpenClaw agent a set of markdown logs for failures, user corrections, missing features and better approaches. It helps the agent reuse these notes later, check whether they still hold, and promote the useful ones into workspace guidance files.
summary.zh: 这个技能为 OpenClaw 智能体提供一组 markdown 日志，用来记录命令失败、用户纠正、缺失的功能以及更好的做法。智能体之后可以复用这些记录，检查其是否仍然成立，并把有用的内容提升为工作区的指导文件。

tagline.en: Prediction market trading for AI agents, practice first
tagline.zh: 面向AI代理的预测市场交易，默认模拟盘

summary.en: This skill teaches an AI agent to register with Simmer and trade prediction markets through one SDK. It covers Polymarket and Kalshi, plus a virtual $SIM venue for practice. It also sets safety limits such as trade caps, daily caps and a default stop-loss.
summary.zh: 这个技能教AI代理注册Simmer，并通过同一套SDK交易预测市场。它支持Polymarket和Kalshi，另有用于练习的虚拟$SIM市场。技能还内置安全限制，包括单笔上限、每日上限和默认止损。

tagline.en: Guide for creating and updating Claude skills
tagline.zh: 用于创建和更新 Claude 技能的指南

summary.en: skill-creator guides you through building a new Claude skill or updating an existing one. It covers the skill folder layout, the SKILL.md format, and the steps from planning to packaging. It helps keep each skill short and focused on knowledge Claude does not already have.
summary.zh: skill-creator 指导你创建新的 Claude 技能，或更新已有的技能。它说明技能的文件夹结构、SKILL.md 的格式，以及从规划到打包的步骤。它帮助每个技能保持简短，只包含 Claude 原本不知道的内容。

tagline.en: Scans a ClawHub skill before it is installed
tagline.zh: 安装 ClawHub 技能前先扫描，有风险则阻止

summary.en: skill-guard runs a guarded ClawHub installation for a slug you name. It stages the skill in a private directory, scans every file with Snyk Agent Scan, and installs only if the scan is complete and clean. It blocks installation on any security finding or incomplete scan.
summary.zh: skill-guard 为你指定的 ClawHub 技能执行带安全检查的安装。它先把技能放入私有暂存目录，再用 Snyk Agent Scan 扫描每个文件，只有扫描完整且结果干净才会正式安装。发现安全问题或扫描不完整时，安装会被阻止。

tagline.en: Security checks before installing an AI agent skill
tagline.zh: 安装智能体技能前的安全审查

summary.en: skill-vetter is a vetting protocol for AI agent skills. It gives the agent a fixed set of checks to run before installing a skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or another source. The result is a written report with red flags, required permissions, a risk level, and a verdict.
summary.zh: skill-vetter 是一套用于审查 AI 智能体技能的流程。它让智能体在从 ClawdHub、GitHub 或其他来源安装技能前，按固定清单逐项检查。检查结束后会生成一份书面报告，包含风险信号、所需权限、风险等级和结论。

tagline.en: React, pin, send and edit Slack messages via Clawdbot
tagline.zh: 通过 Clawdbot 操作 Slack 消息与置顶

summary.en: This skill lets Clawdbot control Slack through the `slack` tool. It covers reacting to messages, pinning and unpinning items, sending, editing and deleting messages, reading recent messages, and fetching member info and the custom emoji list. The tool uses the bot token configured for Clawdbot.
summary.zh: 这个技能让 Clawdbot 通过 `slack` 工具控制 Slack。它支持给消息添加表情反应、置顶和取消置顶、发送、编辑和删除消息、读取近期消息，以及查询成员信息和自定义表情列表。工具使用为 Clawdbot 配置的 bot token。

tagline.en: Command-line control for Sonos speakers on your network
tagline.zh: 通过命令行控制局域网中的 Sonos 音箱

summary.en: sonoscli is a command-line tool called `sonos` that controls Sonos speakers on the local network. It covers discovery, playback, volume, grouping, favorites, the queue, and Spotify search through SMAPI. It lets you control speakers from a terminal or a script.
summary.zh: sonoscli 提供一个名为 `sonos` 的命令行工具，用于控制局域网中的 Sonos 音箱。它支持发现设备、播放控制、音量调节、分组、收藏夹、播放队列，以及通过 SMAPI 搜索 Spotify。你可以在终端或脚本中直接控制音箱。

tagline.en: Control Spotify playback and search from the terminal
tagline.zh: 在终端中控制 Spotify 播放与搜索

summary.en: This skill lets you search Spotify and control playback from the command line. It uses spogo as the preferred tool and spotify_player as a fallback. It is for people who want to play music without opening the Spotify app.
summary.zh: 这个技能让你在命令行中搜索 Spotify 并控制播放。优先使用 spogo，spotify_player 作为备用。适合不想打开 Spotify 应用、只想在终端里听歌的人。

tagline.en: Stripe API access through Maton, with approval for writes
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 访问 Stripe API，写操作需确认

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Stripe API through the Maton gateway, using managed OAuth. The Stripe credential stays in the gateway and is not handled locally. It covers customers, subscriptions, invoices, products, prices, and payments, and it can also set up hosted functions and triggers that run Stripe actions automatically.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton 网关调用 Stripe API，使用托管的 OAuth 认证。Stripe 凭据保留在网关内，不在本地处理。它覆盖客户、订阅、发票、产品、价格和支付，还可以设置托管函数和触发器，自动执行 Stripe 操作。

tagline.en: Scheduled tech news digests from six source types
tagline.zh: 面向定期发布的科技新闻摘要生成工具

summary.en: Collects tech news from RSS feeds, Twitter/X accounts, GitHub releases and trending repos, Reddit, and web search. It scores, merges, and deduplicates the results, then formats them as a digest for Discord, email, or PDF. It is built for regular daily or weekly digests without manual collection.
summary.zh: 从 RSS 订阅、Twitter/X 账号、GitHub 发布与趋势仓库、Reddit 和网页搜索收集科技新闻。系统会对结果评分、合并并去重，再生成 Discord、邮件或 PDF 格式的摘要。适合每天或每周定时生成摘要，无需手动逐个查看各个来源。

tagline.en: Tencent COS storage and CI media and document processing
tagline.zh: 腾讯云COS存储与数据万象处理

summary.en: This skill gives a developer one entry point for Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS) and Data Processing Service (CI, 数据万象). It covers file and bucket management, image, document, media, content review, voice and knowledge base tasks. It runs as Node.js scripts that return JSON.
summary.zh: 这个技能为开发者提供一个入口，用于管理腾讯云对象存储（COS）并调用数据万象（CI）能力。覆盖文件和存储桶管理、图片、文档、媒体、内容审核、语音和知识库等任务。它以 Node.js 脚本运行，输出 JSON。

tagline.en: Create, read, edit and manage Tencent Docs files
tagline.zh: 创建、读取、编辑和管理腾讯文档

summary.en: tencent-docs is a skill that gives an agent tools for Tencent Docs (docs.qq.com) through its MCP server. It creates online documents of several types, reads and searches them, edits smart documents and sheets, manages files and knowledge base spaces, and clips web pages or uploads local files. It removes the need to do these steps by hand in the Tencent Docs web interface.
summary.zh: tencent-docs 是一个技能，通过腾讯文档 MCP 服务为智能体提供操作 docs.qq.com 的工具。它可以创建多种类型的在线文档，读取和搜索文档内容，编辑智能文档、表格和智能表格，管理文件和知识库空间，还能做网页剪藏和本地文件上云。用户不必再手动在腾讯文档网页里逐步操作。

tagline.en: Generate images from text with no API key
tagline.zh: 无需API Key的文生图工具

summary.en: Text-to-image skill for the agent. It takes a text description, sends it to the Pollinations.ai free API through curl, and returns the generated image file. It needs no API key, so you can make images without setting up an image provider account.
summary.zh: 这是一个供智能体使用的文生图技能。它把用户给出的文字描述通过 curl 发送到 Pollinations.ai 免费 API，再把生成的图片文件返回给用户。无需 API Key，不必先注册图像服务账号。

tagline.en: Structured thinking frameworks for analysis and decisions
tagline.zh: 用于深入分析与决策的20种思维框架

summary.en: This skill provides 20 human thinking frameworks for deep analysis and decision-making, such as critical thinking, first principles, red team, and premortem. You name the framework you want, and the agent applies its steps to your topic. It is useful when a decision needs more structure than a quick answer.
summary.zh: 本技能提供20种思维框架，用于深入分析和决策，例如批判性思维、第一性原理、红队和事前验尸。你指定所需框架后，代理会把该框架的步骤应用到你的主题上。当一个决定需要比快速回答更多的结构时，它会有帮助。

tagline.en: Drive interactive CLIs through tmux panes
tagline.zh: 通过 tmux 窗格远程操作交互式命令行程序

summary.en: The tmux skill lets an agent start an interactive program in a tmux session, send it keystrokes, and read its output from the pane. It is meant for tools that need a TTY, such as Python REPLs and coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It also gives helper commands for finding sessions and waiting for text to appear.
summary.zh: tmux 技能可以让智能体在 tmux 会话中启动交互式程序，向其发送按键，并从窗格中读取输出。它适用于需要终端（TTY）的工具，例如 Python REPL，以及 Codex、Claude Code 等编码智能体。技能还提供查找会话和等待指定文本出现的辅助脚本。

tagline.en: Manage Todoist tasks and projects through managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 管理 Todoist 任务和项目

summary.en: A Todoist API v1 integration for creating, updating, completing and organizing tasks, projects, sections, labels and comments. It runs through the maton CLI, and Maton manages the OAuth authorization. It can also run Todoist actions on a schedule or on an event from another connected app, using hosted functions and triggers.
summary.zh: Todoist API v1 集成，用于创建、更新、完成和整理任务、项目、分区、标签和评论。通过 maton CLI 运行，授权由 Maton 托管。还可以用托管函数和触发器，按定时计划或其他已连接应用的事件运行 Todoist 操作。

tagline.en: Topic alerts from web search, feeds and GitHub releases
tagline.zh: 监控网页搜索、订阅源和 GitHub 发布

summary.en: topic-monitor checks topics you define on a schedule and alerts you when a result looks important. A topic can combine web search, RSS/Atom feeds and GitHub release feeds. Each result is filtered, scored for importance and labeled with sentiment, so you get alerts for relevant changes and a weekly digest for the rest.
summary.zh: topic-monitor 按计划检查你定义的主题，发现重要结果时发出提醒。一个主题可以同时组合网页搜索、RSS/Atom 订阅源和 GitHub 发布。每条结果都会经过过滤、重要性评分并标注情绪，相关变化即时提醒，其余内容进入每周摘要。

tagline.en: Manage Trello boards, lists, cards and labels from the CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 maton CLI 管理 Trello 看板、卡片与标签

summary.en: This skill lets an agent work with Trello through the maton CLI. It covers boards, lists, cards, checklists, labels and members, using managed OAuth so the user does not handle Trello API keys. Reads run by default, and every write needs the user's approval.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 maton CLI 操作 Trello。它覆盖看板、列表、卡片、清单、标签和成员，使用托管的 OAuth，用户不需要自己处理 Trello 的 API 密钥。默认只做读取和列表操作，每一项写入都需要用户确认。

tagline.en: Tushare data workflows for China market questions
tagline.zh: 把中文财经问题转为 Tushare 数据流程

summary.en: tushare-data turns plain Chinese questions about stocks, funds, indexes, financials, fund flows, sectors, news and macro data into Tushare data workflows. It picks the task type, chooses the interfaces, fetches and cleans the data, and returns a short summary. It is meant for users who ask in everyday language and do not want to work out interface names and fields themselves.
summary.zh: tushare-data 把中文自然语言的财经请求转成 Tushare 数据工作流，覆盖股票、基金、指数、财务、资金流、板块、公告新闻和宏观数据。它先判断任务类型，再选择接口，取数并清洗，最后给出简要结论。适合不想自己查接口名和字段名的用户。

tagline.en: Typeform forms, responses and insights via Maton OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 管理 Typeform 表单与回复

summary.en: This skill lets an agent work with Typeform through the Maton CLI, using a managed OAuth connection. It covers creating forms, reading and managing responses, and reading insights. It can also turn a Typeform call into a hosted function that a schedule or another app's event runs.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI，借助托管的 OAuth 连接使用 Typeform。它支持创建表单、读取和管理回复，以及查看统计洞察。它还能把 Typeform 调用封装成托管函数，由定时任务或其他应用的事件触发运行。

tagline.en: Multi-system fortune readings, computed locally
tagline.zh: 多体系命理解读，本地计算

summary.en: This skill covers many Chinese and Western fortune-reading systems, including BaZi, Ziwei Doushu, Qimen Dunjia, Liuyao, Meihua, Tarot, astrology, numerology, feng shui, palmistry, physiognomy, naming and dress color. It gives one reading from the birth details, question or other input you provide, and it states how complete that input is. All bundled scripts run locally, and the skill is for cultural reference only, not medical, legal, financial or other professional advice.
summary.zh: 本技能涵盖八字、紫微斗数、奇门遁甲、六爻、梅花易数、塔罗、星盘、数字命理、九宫飞星风水、掌纹面相、起名、穿衣搭配等多种中西命理体系。它根据你提供的出生信息、问题或其他资料给出解读，并说明资料的完整程度。所有脚本均在本地运行。本技能仅供文化参考，不替代医疗、法律、财务等专业建议。

tagline.en: Grab a still frame from a video with ffmpeg
tagline.zh: 用 ffmpeg 从视频中截取单帧画面

summary.en: video-frames is a shell script wrapper around ffmpeg. It pulls a single frame from a video file and saves it as an image. You can take the first frame or a frame at a given timestamp.
summary.zh: video-frames 是对 ffmpeg 的 shell 脚本封装。它从视频文件中取出一帧，并保存为图片。可以取第一帧，也可以取指定时间点的帧。

tagline.en: Up to 4-minute AI videos from a single text prompt
tagline.zh: 单条文字提示生成最长4分钟的AI视频

summary.en: This skill generates marketing, explainer, educational, UGC, news-style and cinematic videos from one prompt. It handles the script, scenes, voiceover, lipsync, music and editing in one run. It is for people who need a finished video without producing each part by hand.
summary.zh: 这个技能可以根据一条提示生成营销、讲解、教育、UGC、新闻风格和电影感的视频。脚本、画面、配音、口型同步、配乐和剪辑都在一次运行中完成。适合需要直接拿到成片、而不想逐个环节手动制作的人。

tagline.en: Current weather and forecasts from wttr.in and Open-Meteo
tagline.zh: 查询当前天气与天气预报

summary.en: This skill gets current weather and forecasts by calling two free services with curl. It needs no API key. It covers quick text lookups from wttr.in and JSON data from Open-Meteo.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 curl 调用两个免费的天气服务，获取当前天气和天气预报。无需 API 密钥。文本查询使用 wttr.in，结构化的 JSON 数据使用 Open-Meteo。

tagline.en: WhatsApp Business API calls with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 调用 WhatsApp Business API

summary.en: This skill lets an agent work with the WhatsApp Business API through the Maton CLI. It covers sending messages, managing message templates, handling media, and reading business profile and phone number data. Authentication is handled by Maton's managed OAuth, so the user does not manage API tokens directly.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 使用 WhatsApp Business API。它支持发送消息、管理消息模板、处理媒体文件，以及读取商家资料和电话号码信息。身份验证由 Maton 托管的 OAuth 完成，用户无需直接管理 API 令牌。

tagline.en: Read and manage WooCommerce store data through Maton OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 托管 OAuth 管理 WooCommerce 商店数据

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the WooCommerce REST API through the Maton CLI, using a managed OAuth connection instead of store keys the user handles directly. It covers products, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, taxes, reports, webhooks, payment gateways, store settings, and system status. It also covers hosted functions and triggers for running a WooCommerce action on a schedule.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 调用 WooCommerce REST API，使用托管的 OAuth 连接，而不需要用户自己处理商店密钥。它覆盖商品、订单、客户、优惠券、物流、税务、报表、Webhook、支付网关、商店设置和系统状态。它还提供托管函数和触发器，用于按计划运行 WooCommerce 操作。

tagline.en: Create and edit DOCX files with styles and review marks
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑 DOCX，保持样式与修订标记

summary.en: This skill helps you create, inspect, and edit Microsoft Word (.docx) files. It covers styles, numbering, tracked changes, comments, tables, sections, and compatibility checks. It is built for files where layout or review markup could break during editing.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于创建、检查和编辑 Microsoft Word（.docx）文件。它涵盖样式、编号、修订、批注、表格、节以及兼容性检查。它适用于排版或审阅标记在编辑中容易出错的文件。

tagline.en: Send and fetch encrypted files through an Xdrop server
tagline.zh: 通过 Xdrop 服务器加密收发文件

summary.en: This skill provides two bundled Bun scripts for an Xdrop server. One uploads local files or directories and prints a share link. The other downloads a share link, decrypts the files locally, and saves them.
summary.zh: 这个技能提供两个随附的 Bun 脚本，用于连接 Xdrop 服务器。上传脚本可以上传本地文件或目录，并输出分享链接。下载脚本可以获取分享链接，在本地解密文件并保存。

tagline.en: Xero accounting data through Maton managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 用托管 OAuth 访问 Xero 会计数据

summary.en: This skill gives access to the Xero API through Maton, with OAuth handled for you. You can manage contacts, invoices, payments, bank transactions and accounts, and run financial reports. It can also turn a Xero read into a scheduled or event-driven automation.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 Maton 访问 Xero API，OAuth 授权由 Maton 托管。你可以管理联系人、发票、付款、银行交易和科目，也可以运行财务报表。它还能把 Xero 的读取操作做成定时或事件触发的自动化。

tagline.en: Read and manage YouTube data through managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 读取和管理 YouTube 数据

summary.en: This skill gives agents access to the YouTube Data API v3 through the maton CLI. It covers searching videos, managing playlists, reading channel data, and working with comments and subscriptions. Authentication is handled by Maton, so the user does not manage OAuth tokens directly.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 maton CLI 让智能体访问 YouTube Data API v3。它支持搜索视频、管理播放列表、读取频道数据，以及处理评论和订阅。认证由 Maton 完成，用户无需自行管理 OAuth 令牌。

tagline.en: Zoho Bigin CRM records, pipelines and automation via Maton
tagline.zh: 管理 Zoho Bigin 联系人、公司与销售管道

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Zoho Bigin CRM data through the Maton CLI. It covers contacts, companies, pipelines and products, with managed OAuth so you do not handle tokens yourself. It also documents hosted functions and triggers that can run a Bigin action on a schedule or on an event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让代理通过 Maton CLI 读取和修改 Zoho Bigin CRM 数据。涵盖联系人、公司、销售管道和产品，使用托管的 OAuth，用户无需自己处理令牌。文档还说明了托管函数和触发器的用法，可以按计划或事件运行一次 Bigin 操作。

tagline.en: Zoho Calendar API access with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 访问 Zoho Calendar API

summary.en: Lets an agent read, create, update and delete Zoho Calendar events and calendars through the Maton CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key. Calls run as the user's own Zoho Calendar connection, and an access policy can limit which endpoints it reaches. Read and list calls are the default, and writes need the user's approval.
summary.zh: 让智能体通过 Maton CLI，或使用 Maton API 密钥直接发送 HTTP 请求，读取、创建、更新和删除 Zoho Calendar 的日程和日历。调用使用用户自己的 Zoho Calendar 连接，访问策略可以限制它能调用的接口。默认只做读取和列表调用，写入操作需要用户确认。

tagline.en: Zoho CRM records and org data through the maton CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 maton CLI 管理 Zoho CRM 记录与组织数据

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Zoho CRM data, including leads, contacts, accounts, deals, and other modules. Zoho CRM sign-in is handled by Maton's managed OAuth, so the user does not manage tokens. It can also set up hosted functions and triggers that run Zoho CRM calls on a schedule or on an event.
summary.zh: 这个技能让代理读取和修改 Zoho CRM 数据，包括线索、联系人、客户、商机及其他模块。Zoho CRM 的登录授权由 Maton 托管的 OAuth 处理，用户无需自己管理令牌。它还可以设置托管函数和触发器，按计划或事件运行 Zoho CRM 调用。

tagline.en: Zoho Inventory API access with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: Zoho Inventory API 托管授权访问

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Zoho Inventory records through the Maton CLI. It covers items, sales orders, invoices, purchase orders, bills, contacts, and shipment orders. Authentication runs through a managed OAuth connection, so the user does not handle Zoho tokens directly.
summary.zh: 该技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 读取和修改 Zoho Inventory 的记录，涵盖商品、销售订单、发票、采购订单、账单、联系人和发货单。认证通过托管的 OAuth 连接完成，用户无需直接处理 Zoho 的令牌。

tagline.en: Zoho Mail API access with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 托管 OAuth 的 Zoho Mail 邮件接口

summary.en: This skill gives access to the Zoho Mail API through the maton CLI or raw HTTP with a Maton API key. It covers sending, reading, and searching email, plus managing folders and labels. It also documents how to turn a Zoho Mail connection into scheduled or event-driven automation.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 maton CLI 或带 Maton API 密钥的原始 HTTP 访问 Zoho Mail API。可以发送、读取和搜索邮件，并管理文件夹和标签。文档还说明了如何把 Zoho Mail 连接用于定时或事件触发的自动化。

tagline.en: Read and manage Zoho People HR data through Maton
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 读写 Zoho People 人事数据

summary.en: This skill lets an AI agent read and change Zoho People HR data. It covers employees, departments, designations, attendance, leave, and any form configured in the Zoho People account, including custom forms. Calls go through the Maton CLI or raw HTTP with a Maton API key, and they use the user's own OAuth connection.
summary.zh: 这个技能让 AI 代理读取和修改 Zoho People 的人事数据，包括员工、部门、职位、考勤、请假，以及账户中配置的任意表单（含自定义表单）。调用通过 Maton CLI 完成，或使用 Maton API 密钥直接发送 HTTP 请求，并使用用户自己的 OAuth 连接。

tagline.en: Manage Zoho Recruit candidates, jobs and interviews
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 管理 Zoho Recruit 招聘数据

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and change Zoho Recruit data through the Maton CLI. Candidates, job openings, interviews and applications can be listed, searched, created and updated. The Zoho Recruit credential stays in the Maton gateway and is not handled locally.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 读取和修改 Zoho Recruit 中的数据。可以列出、搜索、创建和更新候选人、职位、面试和申请记录。Zoho Recruit 的凭证保存在 Maton 网关中，不会在本地处理。

tagline.en: Source-first security review for codebases and services
tagline.zh: 基于源码的安全审计与漏洞复核
